_doc: Per-card hints for make_ex_cosmos_maps.py, keyed by card id. Points and boxes are scan pixels (600 x 838). foil / matte: points forced to that label before the min-cut; cut / add: boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] cleared from or added to the foil area after it; area 'window': the whole window is foil; dots 'window': every shape found lights; sal_max: the salience above which a shape stays dark (default 0.5); borrow: a flat scan of the holo print (path under the refs folder) whose shapes are registered onto a scan of the plain print; params: overrides of P; version: a redrawn map's -vN after shipping.
